findings.summary: Independently rechecked the prior #59 source-metadata/accounting P1s against the supplied full source: the GitHub path now rejects missing/malformed size (bounded nonnegative int, 128001 previously rejected by >128000) and requires a 40-hex blob SHA, raising StorageError rather than allowing unknown metadata; this is fail-closed and no longer the reported bypass. Interrupted prepared work is durably rewritten to source_outcome_unknown before continue, never re-read or refunded, and retained calls are explicitly labeled conservative_upper_bound with separate unknown_tool_calls, matching intentional no-double-spend semantics. Source hashing is applied to content the review note requires, content-filter-before-expression ordering is correct in the supplied comprehension, and no P0/P1 executable defect was found in the supplied files; therefore verdict is SHIP_OK.
